newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan Formosa to buy 1.5 mln T/yr naphtha by '98.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Formosa to buy 1.5 mln T/yr naphtha by '98.

text.p: Taiwan's Formosa Petrochemical Corporation (FPC) is seeking to import 1.5 million tonnes per year (40,000 barrels-per-day) of light naphtha by early 1998 for its new cracker, industry sources said on Tuesday.

Part of the Formosa Plastics Group, FPC will handle all the trading, including imports of crude and feedstock and product exports of the new 450,000 bpd crude refinery and 1.35 million tonne per year naphtha cracker.
The commissioning of the cracker in the second quarter of 1998 and the refinery a year later, will break the monopoly of only oil products producer and the only oil importer.
FPC has not yet to make plans on its future crude purchases but may buy half of its naphtha requirements on term and half on spot, a source said.
